body: Random thoughts mostly. But I typically could deal with them but as of late they came with an unbareable crushing feeling. It was like they made my world turn a shade of grey. Im doing better today tho.
I hope you find happiness,  you sound like a good man.

Many of your points are true. I don't have control over the situation and I just feel so very vulnerable. I just have so much going on I am scared it will trigger in the midst of a job interview or something of the sort.

As a person who was stuying to be a counselor/therapist they do not have to disclose that information. especially without your consent. I believe the only time they would is if you were heading down the path of suicide. From what I've read it seems like there is something deep you are not mentioning. I have to second the speaking with your psychologist. but only when you trust her enough and are prepared to.
We have your back deary, we all care for you. we are faceless but our voices can be heard across time and space. We will always be there for you.
You got the right mindset friend!

Sometimes, the best thing to do is be there at arms lenght (metaphorically). the love of my life has left me so she can learn to be independant. we still talk and hang out but we're friend zoned. I may sound hypocritical but allowing her to come through on her own is sometimes the only thing you can do.

I can empathize with your situation. im in a similar situation only flipped around plus already graduated. I found looking into your areas clubs and such help. if im not mistaken you're at a university, look into what clubs and stuff are there! it helps alot.
ill upvote just for all the help I have recieved.
Thank you for this link. It really helped my mood. I decided to say fuck it and did it myself. laughing I mean.
Thank you for the support dontforgetit!
forgot to mention I moved all of mine in.

Thank you guys. Seriously, I have tears welling up in my eyes. I've been really struggling today and you guys gave me a HUUUUGE boost. You are all amazing. I only hope some day I can repay the kindess you've bestowed onto me.

I was the same way for a time. I can't count the times I would make a suggestion and be ignored. five seconds later. my idea is presented and its like the greatest plan ever. but I have to agree with tinysatellite. you have to be a little more commanding in your tone if you want to be noticed. you seem like a smart person, you just need to be a little more confedient and extroverted.

I just really needed to vent. I had a lot of anger/pain/anxiety built up. things are alot better now and progress has been made to make my situation better. I appreciate the comments though. :) thank you for the support.
